title: Thunder-DeID+: Boundary-Aware Korean De-identification from Court Judgments to Broader Sensitive Documents
abstract: arXiv:2610.22733v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This study examines the transferability of a de-identification model developed for Korean court judgments to a broader range of sensitive documents, focusing on boundary precision, label granularity, and recall. The agglutinative structure of Korean causes Byte Pair Encoding (BPE) tokenizers to frequently merge Personally Identifiable Information (PII) with adjacent particles, which complicates accurate span recovery. Furthermore, current PII taxonomies lack sufficient granularity for legal texts. To address these issues, this study introduces Thunder-DeID+, which integrates a refined three-tier PII taxonomy with a boundary-aware tokenizer. The tokenizer enhances a pretrained BPE vocabulary by incorporating N-gram and boundary-scoring components to better align token and PII span boundaries. translated_title: Thunder-DeID+：从韩国法院判决书到更广泛敏感文档的边界感知韩语去标识化
translated_abstract: 本研究考察了为韩国法院判决书开发的去标识化模型向更广泛敏感文档迁移的能力，重点关注边界精度、标签粒度和召回率。韩语的黏着语结构导致字节对编码（BPE）分词器经常将个人身份信息（PII）与相邻的助词合并，这使得准确恢复文本跨度变得复杂。此外，现有的PII分类体系对法律文本缺乏足够的粒度。为解决这些问题，本研究提出了Thunder-DeID+，它将精炼的三级PII分类体系与边界感知分词器相结合。该分词器通过引入N-gram和边界评分组件来增强预训练的BPE词表，以更好地对齐分词与PII跨度的边界。所提出的方法采用与分词器无关的词段级评估协议进行评估。在完整长度的判决书上，该分词器持续……
tldr: 提出Thunder-DeID+框架，通过结合精炼的三级PII分类体系与融合N-gram和边界评分组件的边界感知分词器，解决了韩语黏着语结构下BPE分词与PII跨度边界不对齐的问题，并将法院判决书的去标识化能力扩展至更广泛的敏感文档。
en_tdlr: Thunder-DeID+ combines a refined three-tier PII taxonomy with a boundary-aware tokenizer that enhances pretrained BPE vocabulary using N-gram and boundary-scoring components, addressing token-PII span misalignment in Korean de-identification and extending from court judgments to broader sensitive documents.
